title: Conversational Execution Claim 1.1
description: Persisted write-once (O_CREAT|O_EXCL via authority.publish_once()) at mission_dir/action_claims/<action_id>.json by tools/hokage_orchestrator/skill_runtime.py's _publish_execution_claim(), and validated at runtime by verify_execution_claim(). New artifact type - there is no 1.0.0 predecessor. The key set is closed (additionalProperties: false) because skill_runtime._CLAIM_REQUIRED_KEYS is checked with an exact set() match, not a subset check - any extra or missing key fails closed with execution_claim_invalid.
